purpose: Modern Python packaging metadata. Defines the setuptools build backend, Python 3.10+ support, dev extra, pytest discovery, package/module inclusion, and ascii-telnet-server console script.
invariants: requires-python must stay aligned with README and CI matrix.
tool.pytest.ini_options.testpaths keeps pytest focused on tests/.
py-modules must include ascii_telnet_server so the console script target is packaged.
gotchas: Do not re-add deprecated license classifiers when using the SPDX license expression; current setuptools rejects that combination.
